value.title: Fixed-law deterministic-map transplant family
value.summary: Fix the two exact rational 2x4x4x9 auxiliary laws from source rows 6 and 7 of the pinned certificate. For each law, map its nine source input labels deterministically to the four half-skew BSSC two-use super-inputs and evaluate the induced half-weight Marton functional. This defines exactly 2·4^9 finite candidates and does not include stochastic relabelings, altered auxiliary laws, mixtures, continuations, or reoptimization.

value.title: Exhaustive fixed-law transplant certificate verifier
value.summary: A dependency-free Python standard-library verifier pins the exact rational source certificate, constructs outward entropy intervals, and visits all 524,288 law-map pairs. It fail-closes on source drift, malformed probability tables, incomplete map coverage, interval inconsistencies, or failure of the strict directed RTD comparison.

value.title: Exhaustive two-law deterministic-map enclosure
value.summary: The exhaustive scan encloses the maximum half-weight Marton value over the two fixed-law deterministic-map families in [0.5451904011322205365, 0.5451904011322206215] bits per two uses. Source row 7 with base-four map ID 243761, decoded as (1,0,3,0,0,2,3,2,3), attains the certified lower endpoint. No interior value or additional decimal precision is asserted.

value.title: Exhaustive no-gain certificate for two fixed transplanted laws
value.summary: For the two pinned exact rational auxiliary laws, every deterministic map of the nine source labels to the four half-skew BSSC two-use super-inputs has half-weight Marton value at most 0.5451904011322206215 bits, strictly below 2L_RTD. The result is confined to this finite fixed-law family and establishes neither unrestricted Marton additivity nor a capacity converse.

placementAudit.rationale: The accepted result rules out a concrete finite auxiliary-law and deterministic-map family as a source of two-letter Marton gain, directly advancing the active multiletter Marton structure-pruning objective.
